implementation.behavior: A visible, keyboard-accessible Rename action and F2 key on a layer row open an inline, labelled name form. Enter or Save commits a trimmed nonempty name through element.update; Escape/Cancel discard the input. Name text is rendered as escaped text. Locked nodes and descendants with locked ancestors cannot be renamed.
implementation.model_and_history: Rename changes only the internal node name in the canonical Page Model and uses the existing command/Undo history; it remains draft-only until Save, while Publish stays explicit.
implementation.public_output: The internal layer name does not appear as public page content after draft Save or Publish.

open_source_review.source: packages/core/src/navigator/view/ItemView.ts at dev: template data-name, double-click edit, Enter/Escape close, model.setName and updateName reconciliation.
open_source_review.decision: The tested interaction informed keyboard activation and model-to-label synchronization. The project uses its own explicit form, Page Model command, Undo/Redo, draft Save/Publish and inherited-lock checks; upstream code is not architecture-compatible as a direct dependency or copy.
